name: Sir Deron, Demilich

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: Four individual Tiny creatures can fit in a square, and a Tiny creature can enter a larger creature’s space and end its turn there. Having a reach of 0 means a Tiny creature cannot make melee attacks against targets outside its own space, unless otherwise noted.

traits.name: Intruding Terror
traits.details: any living creature within the aura takes a -2 penalty to all defenses.

traits.name: Mind Scream
traits.details: any living creature that starts its turn within the aura takes 10 psychic damage.

traits.name: Soul Gems
traits.details: The six soul gems contain spirits of the demilich’s victims. At the start of the encounter, the soul gems contain three souls. Crushing a gem releases the soul to the Shadowfell.

traits.name: Undead Reaction Time
traits.details: The demilich acts two times in a round, on initiative counts 30 and 10. It cannot delay or ready actions. On each turn, it gains a standard action. It can use one immediate action between each turn.

traits.name: Indestructible
traits.details: When the demilich is reduced to 0 hit points, it crumbles into dust (leaving its soul gems behind), but it is not destroyed. The demilich reappears in 1d10 days within 1 square of its phylactery, unless the phylactery is found and destroyed.

auras.name: Intruding Terror

auras.name: Mind Scream
auras.details: any living creature that starts its turn within the aura takes 10 psychic damage.

failedSavingThrows.name: AverageDamage
failedSavingThrows.description: The target is stunned and loses 1d4 healing surges (save ends).

failedSavingThrows.name: AverageDamage
failedSavingThrows.description: The target dies and its soul is trapped in one of the demilich’s soul gems. Sir Deron can have up to six souls trapped in its soul gems at any time. In the Theater of the Fleshless, a target made soulless by this attack is reduced to an empty skin—the perfect costume. The trapped souls can be freed with a Raise Dead ritual

hit.description: necrotic and lightning damage, and the target is dazed (save ends).

miss.description: Half damage, and the target is not dazed. Secondary Attack: Two attacks, each against a different target within 5 squares of the primary target; make these attacks whether the primary attack succeeds or fails; +28 vs. Reflex each; 2d8 + 7 necrotic and lightning damage each

hit.description: cold, fire, lightning, and thunder damage, and the target is stunned until the end of the demilich’s next turn

effect.description: Sir Deron teleports up to 20 squares. Line of sight is not required.
